heading: Everything off. Good night.
body: One sentence for the whole house. The music stops and the rooms go out. The heating stays on, because nobody asked for that.
house: The rooms go out one by one, and the music with them. Only the warm floors are left.

still.name: night
still.alt: Lights out: the card house dark except for the terracotta glow of the heating, the puck quiet in front of it.
